changelog:
Pause and rewind live TV.

WHAT CHANGED

- Settings, Playback has a new Live TV section. Turn on Pause and rewind live TV, and choose how far back you can rewind, from 5 to 90 minutes.
- With it on, pausing a live channel keeps recording in the background, and pressing play carries on from where you paused. The seek bar and the 10-second skip buttons work on live channels, and Back to live jumps to now.
- The recording uses one connection to your provider, the same one you are watching, and it is deleted when you stop watching.
- If the phone has less than 1 GB free, the channel plays live only and the player tells you why. If space runs low while you watch, the app keeps less to rewind into instead of filling the phone.
- Updates also stop if they would leave less than 1 GB free, and say so.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Pause and rewind is off unless you turn it on. With it off, live TV works exactly as before.
- When it is on, the Low latency buffering choice is set aside, because the two work against each other.

NOT YET

- Pause and rewind works on ordinary live channels. Channels your provider sends as an HLS playlist, and catch-up, play without it.
